get_form.description: Look up a form's title and field count.
get_form.name: get_form

parameters.description: ID of the form to look up.
parameters.name: form_id

field_count.description: Number of fields (questions) on the form

list_form_fields.description: List the fields (questions) defined on a form.

fields.title: How satisfied are you with our service?

list_form_fields.name: list_form_fields

parameters.description: ID of the form to list fields for.
parameters.name: form_id

fields.description: List of fields on the form

field_id.description: Field ID, referenced by list-responses answers

type.description: Typeform field type, for example 'multiple_choice' or 'short_text'

list_forms.description: List the forms in your Typeform account.
list_forms.name: list_forms

forms.description: List of forms in the account

id.description: Form ID. Use with the other actions.

list_responses.description: List the responses submitted to a form.
list_responses.name: list_responses

parameters.description: ID of the form to list responses for.
parameters.name: form_id

parameters.description: Maximum number of responses to return (default 25).
parameters.name: max_results

answers.description: The respondent's answers, one per field answered

field_id.description: ID of the field this answer belongs to (matches a field_id from list_form_fields)

description: Connect your Typeform account to browse forms and read their responses.

typeform_new_response_trigger.description: Runs when someone completes and submits a Typeform. Partly filled forms don't count.

output.answers: A list of answers, each with its question, field_id, ref and type. It is not keyed by question, so answers.Name is empty: to use an answer by its question, read fields['Name'].
output.answers_text: Beta. Every answer as a line of text, 'Question: answer', ready for an email, a message, an issue or an AI step to read when the request doesn't name particular questions.
output.email: The respondent's answer to the form's first email question, whatever its wording. Prefer it to fields[...] for an email.
output.fields: The answers keyed by each question's exact wording, such as fields['What is your email?']. The wording is the form owner's, so read only the questions the request names (and say the form must have them); a whole record in a sheet cell or a message reads as code.
output.hidden: The form's hidden fields, as the link set them.
output.landed_at: When the person opened the form.
output.phone_number: The answer to the form's first phone number question, whatever its wording. Empty when the form has none.
output.score: The quiz score, for a form that keeps one.

parameters.description: The form's ID: the code after /to/ in the form's link, such as u6nXL7 in https://example.typeform.com/to/u6nXL7.
parameters.name: form_id
